title: Solo PT / online coach client-management template
core_problem: All-in-one coaching SaaS is expensive/overkill; spreadsheets get chaotic past ~15 clients.
desired_outcome: Manage programming, check-ins and progress without paying for bloated software.
primary_question: Do real people experience this problem, what does it look like, what outcome do they want, what have they tried, what remains unsolved?
